releaseNotes: Implement diagnostics transition state management and animations
changelog: Added DiagnosticsDisplayMode enum to represent different states (IDLE, TRANSITIONING, ACTIVE).
Created DiagnosticsStartTransitionTiming object to define timing constants for animations.
Introduced DiagnosticsTransitionState data class to encapsulate the current state of the diagnostics transition.
Developed DiagnosticsTransitionMachine object to handle state transitions based on user interactions and current state.
Updated DiagnosticsScreen to manage transitions and animations based on the new state management system.
Enhanced UI responsiveness during diagnostics run with animations for idle, transitioning, and active states.
Added unit tests for transition state management to ensure correct behavior during state changes and user interactions.
